item.title: 5 Honey Bee Dance Videos You Can’t Miss!
item.description: Dive into five awe-inspiring migrations: the thundering sardine run off South Africa’s coast; giant manta rays gathering in Indonesia; green sea turtles returning to the exact beaches of their birth; European eels’ 3,000-mile swim from rivers to the Sargasso Sea; and the synchronized mass-spawning of reef fish on Australia’s Great Barrier Reef. Witness nature’s greatest underwater journeys. The post 5 Honey Bee Dance Videos You Can’t Miss! appeared first on One Green Planet.
